text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing that a festival is being held in the local shopping district, Inari One and I decide to pay it a visit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heeey, I'm likin' the lively vibes! This is what I mean when I say festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Huh? That's…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri! You're here too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I caught a whiff of something delicious, so I came running straight over.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, that's so like you. Well then, how 'bout takin' a stroll 'round the stalls together?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. I was just getting ready to go for a second round.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What?! Ya already ate?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Inari One, myself, and Oguri Cap begin walking around the festival. As we do…

text_block_list.name: Festival Event Staff A
text_block_list.text: What's that?! We can't carry the mikoshi shrine?!

text_block_list.name: Festival Event Staff B
text_block_list.text: What should we do?! Everyone is already waiting for us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey? What's this? Are they arguin'?

text_block_list.name: Festival Event Staff A
text_block_list.text: Long story short, a fire broke out nearby, and all the folks who usually carry the mikoshi shrine went to help out.

text_block_list.name: Festival Event Staff B
text_block_list.text: All of the people who came to see it are gonna leave if… Oh, I know! If you could help us—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Say no more! Ya want us to haul the shrine, right?

text_block_list.name: Festival Event Staff B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I know it's a lot to ask. But, would ya?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, I'd love to carry it, but I think we can help in a different way.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I can't manage it alone. So, Trainer, Oguri, think you two could lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Gather 'round! Ya can't afford to miss this! The showdown of the century is 'bout to start!

text_block_list.name: Festival Goer
text_block_list.text: Hm? What the heck? Where did all the yakisoba and takoyaki go?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Behold, the queen of gluttony herself, Oguri Cap! She's the demoness with an abyssal appetite!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hello, I'm the demoness with an abyssal appetite. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Challengin' the queen is none other than me, Inari One! The food's piled up like Mt. Fuji! First to polish it all off's the winner!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's get it on! Reeeady… GO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the support from the people at the festival stalls and the shopping district, the eating contest gets underway. A crowd gathers, excited to spectate…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey! Lookie here! The star of the show's arrived!

text_block_list.name: Festival Palanquin Carriers
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Festival Goers
text_block_list.text: Oooh! The shrine is here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Betcha this excitement can be felt even in the heavens. Right… shall we call it a day?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What? We're done already? But we haven't decided a winner…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We were just stallin' till the main act arrived. Our job is done!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Take a look at the folks hoistin' the shrine. And look at the sparkle in the crowd's eyes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Competin' for attention would just spoil the fun! C'mon, let's wrap up the leftovers for later and head out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whew. Now that that's all over, I'm feelin' wiped!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The festival folks got to save face, and we bought 'em some time. Not too shabby, right?
choice_data_list: I was hoping to crown a winner in that eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The festival folks got to save face, and we bought 'em some time. Not too shabby, right?
choice_data_list: I was hoping to crown a winner in that eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's what I should be sayin' to you guys.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oguri really put on one helluva show. Guess it's just business as usual for you though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Let's not forget the one runnin' every which way to gather up the food for the contest. That'd be you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh heh. Sheesh… since when did you become so dependable?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's how our classy trio stepped up and saved the festival from near disaster.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa! Ya wanna put me up against Oguri for real?! Talk about cruel…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But we've still got the leftovers from earlier. Why don't we pick up where we left off?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And you're still down to tussle? Well, in that case, no way I'm backin' out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Bring on th grub!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One stakes her Edo pride and steps up to the plate only to be utterly defeated by Oguri Cap's monstrous appetite.
